title: Measuring Epistemic Humility in Multimodal Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. The benchmark, HumbleBench, is designed to evaluate 'epistemic humility' in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), specifically their ability to reject plausible but incorrect answers (i.e., avoid hallucination) in visual question answering tasks across object, relation, and attribute categories.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this topic is outside the scope of its investigation.
